title: Demonstrate accounting for change in accounting estimate including a change in accounting estimate effected by change in accounting principle

items.concept: Prospective change in useful life and residual; multi-year period-end adjusting JEs (emphasis); subsequent measurement schedules before/after change; disposal
Number-variant twin: prospective life/residual revision; multi-year period-end adjusting JEs; subsequent measurement schedules; disposal with loss
Change from SL to DDB as change in estimate effected by change in principle; prospective DDB subsequent measurement schedule; multi-year period-end AJEs; disposal
Intangible initial recognition; subsequent amortization schedule; prospective life revision; multi-year period-end AJEs; abandonment/disposal write-off
Classification — pure change in estimate vs estimate effected by principle vs retrospective principle change; prospective application
Period-end adjusting JE implements pure change in estimate — no restatement or cumulative catch-up
